name: JD-Bench
description: JD-Bench is a Hugging Face-hosted benchmark collection intended to evaluate language model performance on text-centric tasks associated with the JD-Bench suite. It aggregates evaluation instances aimed at testing understanding, reasoning and generation capabilities in textual scenarios. The dataset is used as a task suite for model comparison rather than a single narrowly focused task.
reputation: Relatively low visibility compared with major benchmarks; primarily used by a smaller research community.
